summary.en: The generated docs page as one object: six panels on paper (title bar, endpoint list, reference, code sample, response, SDK chips), the list highlight on the followed endpoint.
summary.zh: 把生成的文档页当成一件道具：纸色上的六块面板（标题栏、接口列表、说明、代码示例、响应、SDK 标签），列表高亮停在跟踪的接口上。

fits: Any film about APIs, SDKs or generated documentation.
notFor: Real product screenshots (use a device frame).

intent.en: Generated docs look complete at a glance: list, reference, code, response and SDKs in one page.
intent.zh: 生成的文档一眼看上去就是完整的：列表、说明、代码、响应、SDK 都在一页里。

content.en: The product facts (title, version, file, 2–6 endpoints, body, call, SDKs), a reference title (≤ 24 / 12 字), a code sample.
content.zh: 产品事实（标题、版本、文件、2–6 个接口、响应体、调用、SDK），说明页标题（≤ 24 字符 / 12 字），代码示例。

fits.zh: 任何讲 API、SDK 或生成文档的片。

notFor.zh: 真实产品截图（用设备框）。

en: It is a schematic page; do not put a real product's screenshot style on it.
zh: 这是示意页；不要套真实产品的截图样式。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
